# PromptAI

> PromptAI is a free web app that turns a rough idea into a powerful, ready-to-use AI prompt in seconds. It asks smart follow-up questions (names, company, dates, tone) for emails and letters, can turn an image or screenshot into an exact recreate-this-image prompt, and opens the prompt in ChatGPT, Gemini or Claude.

PromptAI was created by Dhaval soni, a UI/UX designer and developer from Gujarat, India, as a final-year BCA project.
